description: This file declares the WebSocketDeflateStream class, a subclass of WebSocketStream, which implements permessage-deflate WebSocket extension with deflation and inflation capabilities, including methods for reading, writing, and managing WebSocket frames with compression.

classes.name: net::WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: A subclass of WebSocketStream that handles permessage-deflate compression and decompression for WebSocket frames, managing frame deflation/inflation, and maintaining read/write states.

methods.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the deflate stream with a wrapped WebSocketStream, deflate parameters, and a predictor.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames, inflating compressed frames as needed.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Writes WebSocket frames, deflating frames before sending.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous read operations.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a message frame.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Appends a compressed frame to the output.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Appends a message that may be compressed.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Inflates frames if necessary and reads them.
